description: Add autonomous dispatch engine: extend DriverRecommendation type with dispatch tracking fields, implement autonomousDispatch() in FleetManager with constraint validation and atomic rollback, wire it into the pipeline scheduler Stage 6, fix cancelRecommendation to release EN_ROUTE vehicles, add updateRecommendation method to store, add GET /api/dispatch/status endpoint and deprecate manual dispatch endpoint with 410. These are the backend changes that make dispatch fully autonomous with no manual approval step.
steps: 1. Edit src/lib/types.ts: Add optional fields to DriverRecommendation interface — dispatchedAt?: string; dispatchError?: string; autonomousDispatch?: boolean; — do NOT add dispatchLock (handle via status check). Do NOT remove or rename existing fields.

2. Edit src/db/store.ts: Add updateRecommendation(id: string, patch: Partial<DriverRecommendation>): boolean method that merges patch onto the stored rec and calls saveToDisk(). The existing upsertRecommendation() already persists the full object including the new optional fields so no change needed there.

3. Edit src/lib/fleet.ts: Add autonomousDispatch(rec: DriverRecommendation, nowIso?: string) public method to FleetManager class. Implementation: (a) If rec.status === 'DISPATCHED' or 'COMPLETED', return {success:false, assignedVehicleIds:[], error:'Already dispatched'}. (b) Validate rec.estimatedTravelDistanceKm <= 12.0, rec.estimatedTravelTimeMin <= 32, rec.recommendedVehicleCount >= 2 — return failure with specific message on violation. (c) Filter rec.allocatedVehicleIds: keep only vehicles that are AVAILABLE, batteryOrFuelLevel >= 20, zoneId === rec.sourceZoneId, no assignedRecommendationId. (d) If eligible.length < 2, return failure. (e) Count remaining AVAILABLE in sourceZoneId after removal: if remaining < 3 AND all surplus is being used, return failure to preserve reserve. (f) Commit: for each eligible vehicle call persistentStore.updateVehicle(vid, {state:'EN_ROUTE', targetZoneId, targetZoneName, assignedRecommendationId:rec.id, movementStartedAt:nowIso, estimatedArrivalAt: new Date(Date.parse(nowIso)+rec.estimatedTravelTimeMin*60000).toISOString(), movementProgressPct:0, repositionCountToday:vehicle.repositionCountToday+1, lastStateChange:nowIso}). Track assigned[]. On any updateVehicle false, rollback all assigned so far (set back to AVAILABLE with cleared fields), return failure. (g) Return {success:true, assignedVehicleIds:assigned}. Import DriverRecommendation from './types' at top of file.

4. Edit src/lib/pipelineScheduler.ts Stage 6: Remove the existing for-loop that calls globalFleetManager.assignRepositioning() directly. Instead: (a) Before the deficit loop, build a Set of 'sourceZoneId:targetZoneId' pairs from recommendations created in the last 15 minutes that are already DISPATCHED (load from persistentStore.getRecommendations(), filter by createdAt within last 900 seconds and status DISPATCHED). (b) In the match block when moveCount >= 2, create rec with status:'PENDING' and autonomousDispatch:true. (c) Skip if this sourceZoneId:targetZoneId pair is in the already-dispatched set. (d) Call const dispatchResult = globalFleetManager.autonomousDispatch(rec, cycleTimestamp.toISOString()). (e) If success: set rec.status='DISPATCHED', rec.dispatchedAt=cycleTimestamp.toISOString(), rec.allocatedVehicleIds=dispatchResult.assignedVehicleIds. (f) If failure: set rec.status='PENDING', rec.dispatchError=dispatchResult.error. (g) Always persistentStore.upsertRecommendation(rec) and push to generatedRecommendations. Remove the separate assignRepositioning() for-loop entirely.

5. Edit src/lib/recommendations.ts cancelRecommendation(): After setting rec.status='CANCELLED' and before updating the store, add: const nowIso = new Date().toISOString(); for (const vid of rec.allocatedVehicleIds) { const v = persistentStore.getVehicle(vid); if (v && v.state === 'EN_ROUTE' && v.assignedRecommendationId === rec.id) { persistentStore.updateVehicle(vid, { state: 'AVAILABLE', targetZoneId: undefined, targetZoneName: undefined, assignedRecommendationId: undefined, movementStartedAt: undefined, estimatedArrivalAt: undefined, movementProgressPct: 0, lastStateChange: nowIso }); } }

6. Edit server.ts: (a) Add GET /api/dispatch/status route before the existing recommendations routes. Compute: lastCycle from persistentStore.getLatestCycleRun(); all recs from persistentStore.getRecommendations(); return {autonomousDispatchEnabled:true, mode:'AUTONOMOUS', lastCycleTimestamp: lastCycle?.timestamp||null, lastCycleId: lastCycle?.runId||null, dispatchedThisCycle: lastCycle?.recommendationsGeneratedCount||0, pendingCount: allRecs.filter(r=>r.status==='PENDING').length, dispatchedCount: allRecs.filter(r=>r.status==='DISPATCHED').length, failedCount: allRecs.filter(r=>!!r.dispatchError).length, enRouteVehicles: globalFleetManager.getFleetStateSummary().enRoute}. (b) Replace POST /api/recommendations/:id/dispatch handler body with: res.status(410).json({error:'Manual dispatch is no longer supported. Recommendations are dispatched autonomously by the 15-minute pipeline.', code:'ENDPOINT_DEPRECATED'}).
acceptance_criteria: npm run lint passes with zero TypeScript errors after all changes
GET /api/dispatch/status returns 200 with autonomousDispatchEnabled:true and mode:'AUTONOMOUS'
POST /api/recommendations/:id/cancel for a DISPATCHED rec releases EN_ROUTE vehicles to AVAILABLE state
Pipeline cycle run produces recommendations with status DISPATCHED (not PENDING) and sets dispatchedAt field
A recommendation that is already DISPATCHED is not re-dispatched if pipelineScheduler runs again within 15 min window
verification: npm run lint — must show zero TypeScript errors
npm run test — all existing tests in algorithms.test.ts, auth.test.ts, n8nWorkflow.test.ts must still pass
findings: 1. autonomousDispatch() is a public method on FleetManager (src/lib/fleet.ts) and is the single authoritative dispatch path. It enforces: distance ≤12km, travel time ≤32min, batch ≥2 vehicles, battery ≥20%, source reserve ≥3 AVAILABLE, atomic rollback on partial failure. 2. pipelineScheduler.ts Stage 6 now calls globalFleetManager.autonomousDispatch() instead of assignRepositioning(). Recommendations start as PENDING then flip to DISPATCHED (with dispatchedAt) on success, or stay PENDING (with dispatchError) on failure. 3. The duplicate-cycle guard uses a Set of 'sourceZoneId:targetZoneId' pairs from recommendations with status=DISPATCHED created within the last 15 minutes — preventing re-dispatch of the same zone pair in back-to-back cycles. 4. cancelRecommendation() in recommendations.ts now releases EN_ROUTE vehicles back to AVAILABLE when a DISPATCHED recommendation is cancelled. 5. GET /api/dispatch/status returns autonomousDispatchEnabled:true, mode:AUTONOMOUS, lastCycleTimestamp, lastCycleId, dispatchedThisCycle, pendingCount, dispatchedCount, failedCount, enRouteVehicles. 6. POST /api/recommendations/:id/dispatch returns 410 with code:ENDPOINT_DEPRECATED. 7. store.ts has new updateRecommendation(id, patch) method for partial updates. 8. DriverRecommendation type has new optional fields: dispatchedAt, dispatchError, autonomousDispatch. 9. Pre-existing test failure: n8nWorkflow.test.ts 'Structural integrity' fails because n8n/vizimove_event_intelligence_workflow.json contains literal string 'vizimove_secret_api_key_example' (matches 'secret_' check) — this is NOT caused by FEAT-001. 10. FEAT-002 (frontend) should use GET /api/dispatch/status for the autonomous banner. The globalRecommendationEngine (LEGACY) is still seeded on startup and its recommendations appear in the store — FEAT-002 may want to distinguish pipeline recs (autonomousDispatch:true) from legacy recs (autonomousDispatch undefined).
